items.title: Paul Barbarin Interview, 1957-03-27
items.q: Might have been, might have been Piku, I don't know.

ctx.x: That's, that's, that's many years back. Gee whiz. Um. Now they had some very good bands. I mean, uh, came behind this band like, uh, the Yama Lipi Band. Well, that band was terrific. It was in there. Yeah, that band was really a mess of me. They, they, they was better than those bands. Well, I got, just got through calling. It was in there. It was in there. It was really in there. They had, uh, they had, uh, Simon Marrero on the bass. They had John Marrero on the guitar. They had, uh, one time when I heard them,…
Did you ever hear the... It's a good band though. Yeah. The T.O.s much? On the clarinet?

items.title: Paul Barbarin Interview, 1959-01-07
items.q: They had Alphonse P. Kool, and I'm talking about the guys that could read at that time.

ctx.x: On the street they played E flat?

E flat, yeah, he played the E flats. Now, Larenza Tio, I mean, young Larenza, I mean, he was a very good clarinetist. Charlie McCurtis, he was good. They had Alphonse P. Kool, and I'm talking about the guys that could read at that time. I can remember, they had, you know, Big Al Lover, he was around that time, but he was a musician with those guys. He played Ratty, you know, he was a ratty kind of player. Later on in the years, well, I mean, what, Basher and them fellas came up with. But that Basher, Sidney…
Well, who took his place after he left? Who's that? Basher has been the tops.

items.title: Alphonse Picou Interview, 1958-04-04
items.q: Now the best drummer we got is Paul Barbarelli.

ctx.x: Yes. But in the old days it was easy to find a drummer.

Who were some of the best drummers? You mentioned the old man Cantrell. Is that Cantrell or Cottrell? Do you remember? Cottrell. How is it? Cottrell. Cottrell. Yes. Now the best drummer we got is Paul Barbarelli. Yes, he's a drummer. That's the best one right now, on the drum. Yes. Yes. He was a drummer. He beat the last one. He got... Pudum, pum, pum, pum.
Who were the best of them before? Alfonso? Louis Cantrell. Louis Cantrell. And there were other ones as good? That was the king. He was the king.
